description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000 and an opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development. We are looking to fill this role quickly.

The Director of Nursing will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, maintaining regulatory compliance, and fostering a collaborative and supportive environment for nursing staff. This role requires a leader who is passionate about clinical excellence and committed to continuous improvement.

If you are a visionary nursing leader ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and making a difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor nursing staff effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier rehabilitation center in Frostburg, MD, as a Unit Manager, Wound Care Nurse. This full-time role offers a unique opportunity to lead a unit while specializing in critical wound care management, contributing significantly to patient recovery and well-being. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled professional ready to make an immediate impact.In this vital position, you will oversee daily unit operations, ensure high standards of patient care, and provide expert wound care services. Your leadership will be crucial in fostering a collaborative environment and maintaining clinical excellence. The compensation for this role is competitive, reflecting your expertise and commitment.If you are an experienced nurse with a passion for leadership and wound care, and are looking for a challenging yet rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply. This role is ideal for a professional eager to advance their career in a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland (preferred)
Minimum of 2 years of experience in wound care management
Previous experience in a supervisory or leadership capacity within a healthcare setting
Strong clinical assessment, documentation, and communication skills
